blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Quezon City government on Thursday (Oct. 22) issued guidelines for people going to Bagbag and Novaliches public cemeteries for the observance of All Saints’ Day (Undas). In an advisory, it said that the scheduled visitation hours at Bagbag and Novaliches cemeteries will be from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. starting Oct. 31 (Saturday) to Nov. 2 (Monday). The visitation hours for crematorium and columbarium will also be from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. READ: MMDA flags 5 major cemeteries for Undas traffic management Meanwhile, the internment or burial will be suspended from Oct. 31 to Nov. 2.
